paragraphs.text:
Though you put a sizeable bid in for the idol, a truly outrageous 
sum is called, easily twice what you offered. Mr. Warren squints 
hard at the paper before calling out the staggering price and an 
unfamiliar-sounding name: “Banyu.” Confused whispers break 
out as the orange-robed monk collects the statue with a look of 
excitement on his face.
